name: Olympus Mons
origin: Mount Olympus, home of Greek gods; tallest planetary volcano.

name: Ascraeus Mons
origin: Northernmost of the Tharsis Montes.

name: Pavonis Mons
origin: Central shield volcano of Tharsis Montes.

name: Arsia Mons
origin: Southernmost of the Tharsis Montes.

name: Elysium Mons
origin: Volcanic peak in Elysium Planitia.

name: Alba Mons
origin: Broadest volcanic shield on Mars.

name: Valles Marineris
origin: Grand canyon system of Mars; Mariner 9 mission.

name: Kasei Valles
origin: Japanese word for Mars; giant outflow channel.

name: Ares Vallis
origin: Greek god of war; Pathfinder landing site.

name: Mawrth Vallis
origin: Welsh word for Mars; clay-rich ancient outflow.

name: Gale Crater
origin: Walter F. Gale, Australian astronomer; MSL Curiosity site.

name: Jezero Crater
origin: Town in Bosnia and Herzegovina; Mars 2020 Perseverance site.

name: Gusev Crater
origin: Matvey Gusev, Russian astronomer; MER Spirit site.

name: Victoria Crater
origin: Magellan's ship; explored by Opportunity rover.

name: Endeavour Crater
origin: HMS Endeavour; Opportunity rover destination.

name: Korolev Crater
origin: Sergei Korolev, Soviet rocket engineer; filled with permanent water ice.

name: Schiaparelli Crater
origin: Giovanni Schiaparelli, Italian astronomer.

name: Hellas Planitia
origin: Classical name for Greece; deepest impact basin on Mars.

name: Argyre Planitia
origin: Mythical silver island in the Indian Ocean.

name: Isidis Planitia
origin: Egyptian goddess Isis.

name: Utopia Planitia
origin: Nowhere Land; Viking 2 and Zhurong landing site.

name: Acidalia Planitia
origin: Mythological fountain of Venus.

name: Elysium Planitia
origin: Elysian Fields in Greek mythology; InSight lander site.

name: Noctis Labyrinthus
origin: Labyrinth of the night; complex valley network at western Valles Marineris.

name: Aram Chaos
origin: Biblical region; collapsed chaotic terrain rich in hematite.

name: Gorgonum Chaos
origin: Mythological Gorgons; source of recent gullies.

name: Hebes Chasma
origin: Hebes, Greek goddess of youth; closed canyon depression.

name: Melas Chasma
origin: Greek for dark; central and deepest segment of Valles Marineris.

name: Planum Boreum
origin: Northern plain; Martian north polar ice cap.

name: Planum Australe
origin: Southern plain; Martian south polar ice cap.

name: Cerberus Fossae
origin: Cerberus from Greek mythology; seismically active fissures detected by InSight.

name: Tycho Crater
origin: Tycho Brahe, Danish astronomer; prominent lunar ray crater.

name: Copernicus Crater
origin: Nicolaus Copernicus, Polish astronomer.

name: Aristarchus Crater
origin: Aristarchus of Samos; brightest feature on the lunar surface.

name: Kepler Crater
origin: Johannes Kepler, German astronomer.

name: Shackleton Crater
origin: Ernest Shackleton, Antarctic explorer; lunar south pole with permanently shadowed regions.

name: Clavius Crater
origin: Christopher Clavius, Jesuit mathematician; one of the largest lunar craters.

name: Mare Tranquillitatis
origin: Sea of Tranquility; Apollo 11 landing site.

name: Mare Imbrium
origin: Sea of Showers; vast lava-flooded impact basin.

name: Mare Serenitatis
origin: Sea of Serenity; Apollo 17 landing site nearby.

name: Oceanus Procellarum
origin: Ocean of Storms; largest lunar mare.

name: Montes Apenninus
origin: Apennine Mountains; border of Mare Imbrium; Apollo 15 landing site.

name: Conamara Chaos
origin: Celtic mythical region; disrupted matrix of floating ice rafts and chaotic matrix terrain.

name: Pwyll Crater
origin: Welsh Celtic god of the underworld; geologically youthful impact crater with bright rays.

name: Cilix Crater
origin: Brother of Europa in Greek mythology; sharp central-peak crater.

name: Tyre Impact Structure
origin: Ancient Phoenician city where Europa was born; concentric multi-ring impact basin formed in thin ice.

name: Callanish Impact Structure
origin: Place in Scotland known for megalithic stone circle; multi-ring concentric fracture zone.

name: Agenor Linea
origin: Father of Europa; prominent bright linear ridge system shaped by diurnal tidal flexing.

name: Astypalaea Linea
origin: Sister of Europa; prominent strike-slip transform fault cutting through south polar ice.

name: Thera Macula
origin: Greek island of Santorini; low-albedo disrupted chaos depression likely overlying a liquid water lens.

name: Thrace Macula
origin: Historical region in southeast Europe; dark fracture and chaos terrain.

name: Tara Corona
origin: Ancient seat of Irish High Kings; circular volcano-tectonic depression.

name: Rhadamanthys Linea
origin: Son of Europa and Zeus; prominent cycloidal double-ridge lineament.

name: Mannannán Crater
origin: Irish sea god; young central-peak crater with distinct albedo asymmetry.

name: Tegid Crater
origin: Welsh mythological figure; prominent impact basin on Europa leading hemisphere.

name: Taliesin Crater
origin: Welsh Celtic bard; rayed crater with dark ejecta blanket.

name: Morvran Crater
origin: Celtic mythology, son of Tegid; sharp fresh impact crater.

name: Govannan Crater
origin: Welsh god of metalworking; bright rayed impact crater.

name: Maeve Crater
origin: Irish queen of Connacht; northern high-latitude impact depression.

name: Grannos Crater
origin: Celtic god of healing springs; degraded impact basin.

name: Balor Crater
origin: Celtic deity with the venomous eye; northern hemisphere crater.

name: Belus Linea
origin: Brother of Agenor; dark reddish-brown tectonic lineament with double ridge morphology.

name: Minos Linea
origin: Son of Europa and Zeus, King of Crete; northern cycloidal lineament.

name: Cadmus Linea
origin: Brother of Europa, founder of Thebes; prominent strike-slip ridge system.

name: Delphi Linea
origin: Ancient Greek sacred site; high-latitude cycloidal flexure.

name: Pelops Linea
origin: Greek mythological hero; intersecting ridge complex.

name: Libya Linea
origin: Daughter of Epaphus and mother of Agenor; prominent polar ridge.

name: Hippolytus Linea
origin: Greek mythological son of Theseus; curved tidal lineament.

name: Udun Linea
origin: Norse mythological subterranean place; bright tectonic ridge.

name: Tynia Linea
origin: Etruscan supreme god of the sky; intersecting ridge system.

name: Murias Chaos
origin: City of the Tuatha De Danann; extensive disrupted ice-raft terrain.

name: Rathmore Chaos
origin: Irish mythological settlement; thermal disruption matrix.

name: Narberth Chaos
origin: Chief residence of Pwyll in the Mabinogion; ice raft matrix.

name: Castalia Macula
origin: Nymph of the Delphic spring; localized brine upwelling feature.

name: Cyclades Macula
origin: Greek island group; dark albedo cryo-thermal patch.

name: Annwn Regio
origin: Welsh underworld realm; vast leading-hemisphere bright ice terrain.

name: Argadnel Regio
origin: Celtic otherworld earthly paradise; ridged plains terrain.

name: Tara Regio
origin: Seat of Celtic High Kings; extensive trailing-hemisphere disrupted province.

name: Powys Regio
origin: Ancient Welsh kingdom; heavily fractured southern ice plain.

name: Sidon Flexus
origin: Ancient Phoenician city; prominent cycloidal curved cusp formed by diurnal tidal flexing.

name: Delphi Flexus
origin: Sanctuary of Apollo; high-latitude tidal cusp fracture.
